title: solarff: NLFFF extrapolations with a calibrated per-line confidence
description:
Python library for the extrapolation of the solar coronal magnetic field from SDO/HMI vector magnetograms (potential, linear force-free and nonlinear force-free), with field-line tracing, a calibrated per-line confidence, energy and helicity diagnostics, and the scripts that reproduce the results of the associated paper.

Documentation: https://gabgarar.github.io/solarff/
